featured_reviews.name: harshad bhagat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got this tattoo done by Anitesh, and I’m very impressed with the result. The design combines a powerful lion portrait with a Spartan warrior, symbolizing strength, resilience, and courage—and it’s executed beautifully.

The detailing is top-notch, especially in the lion’s face and the muscular definition of the warrior. The shading is smooth and gives the tattoo a realistic depth. The red highlight on the Spartan helmet adds a bold contrast that really makes the design stand out.

What I appreciated most was Anitesh’s precision and patience. The linework is clean, proportions are perfect, and the placement on the arm fits naturally with the body shape. The quote at the bottom is also neatly done and adds a meaningful touch to the entire piece.

Overall, amazing work—professional, creative, and highly skilled. Definitely recommended for anyone looking for detailed and meaningful tattoos

They guided me through the whole process with so much patience and professionalism. The work, the detailing, and the overall experience were truly amazing. I absolutely loved how my tattoo turned out. Highly recommended for anyone getting their first tattoo!”

featured_reviews.name: Sandip Karmakar
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you so much, Anitesh! You perfectly covered up my old tattoo in such an amazing way. I absolutely loved the result. I know this was a very tricky piece, but you handled it beautifully and professionally. You truly gave your best, and it clearly shows in your work. Thank you so much once again! I highly, highly recommend them to anyone looking to get a new tattoo or a cover-up.

featured_reviews.name: Larson Dabre
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came to Anitesh with a piece I’ve wanted to hide. I was worried it was too dark to ever truly disappear, but the result is absolute magic.

Anitesh took the time to explain the color theory behind the cover-up and didn't just 'blast over it' with black. He integrated the old lines into the new flow so naturally that you can't see a trace of the original tattoo, even in direct sunlight. The saturation is incredible, and the placement feels intentional, not forced. If you're looking for someone to fix a past mistake with zero judgment and elite skill, this is the place.
